gradient_check_epsilon_reason: 1e-4 is below float32 resolution of the logit-margin difference. 1e-2 is the instrument step. The scientific alpha grid is unchanged.
negative_result_scope: A negative or partial result says this structure was not found for these models, these prompts, and this declared map. It does not say the structure cannot exist.
